content.text:
I read the brief, conversation, and disclosure first, then traced every claim limitation, every numeral, every description assertion, and every figure-brief geometry statement back to affirmative inventor passages.

**Ledger notes (all traced):**

- **Claim 1 / 11 core chain** — connector channels with contactor + connector current sensor + control-pilot interface + local connector identifier; upstream branch current sensor; stored authorization/requested current/minimum sustaining current/energy-deficit; subtract measured non-charging load and configurable safety reserve; sustaining-first then deficit distribution; pilot send + sensor verification; verification interval after a reduced pilot command; one-at-a-time shedding in a stored order until branch current is below limit — all appear verbatim in the disclosure paragraphs 1–3.
- **Dependents 2–10 / 12–16** — re-measure-and-stop (from "until measured branch current is below the branch limit"), three reclosure conditions, welded-contactor leakage threshold + inhibit + local fault indicator, isolated local bus, network interface/nonvolatile memory/signed token/last accepted limit, outage new-session bar with expiry, tamper-evident meter sequence upload, service-input mapping and agreement-before-storage — each maps to disclosure paragraphs 3–5.
- **Numerals 100–140, 202–216** — each designates exactly one part, each appears in both the description and the figure brief where it is listed, and no numeral is listed on a figure without a corresponding description passage.
- **Figure geometry** — in-line branch sensor upstream of both channel drops and the non-charging load drop is required by the disclosed "measures total current" plus the subtraction of measured non-charging load from the branch limit; connector current sensor downstream of the contactor is required by the disclosed zero-current reclosure test and welded-contactor leakage test; bus reaching pilot interface and contactor matches "communicates with the connector interfaces and contactors over an isolated local bus." Generic squares, blocks, the rounded vehicle outline, and the dashed enclosure are labeled "shown schematically" and carry no proportion, taper, depth, runout, or contact-topology statement; the claims and description stay shape-neutral, and no "by way of example" or "any closed outline" language leaked from the briefs into the application text.
- **FIG. 4 flow** — the seven rectangles plus one diamond, the diamond's below-limit return to step 202, the welded-condition terminator, and the reclosure return path all match the step-by-step narration in the detailed description; no section lines are used, and no drafting note, placeholder, or open question remains anywhere in the draft.

One scoping note for your awareness, not a defect in this draft: `prior_art/` was not part of the material supplied to me, so Background characterizations are left to the later citation-tracing review as instructed.

input.summary: Full source-fidelity preflight run against input/disclosure.md and the USER passage in input/conversation.md as the sole authority, with input/brief.md used only for title/applicant/inventor/priority/government-support formalities. I built a complete ledger and traced all 16 claims limitation by limitation (independent apparatus claim 1 and method claim 11, and dependents 2-10 and 12-16), all 25 reference numerals (100, 102, 104, 106, 108, 110, 112, 114, 116, 118, 120, 122, 124, 126, 128, 130, 140 and steps 202-216), every numbered part and relationship in the field, summary, detailed description and abstract, and all four figure briefs plus the Brief Description of the Drawings. Every limitation maps to an exact affirmative disclosure passage: connector channels each having a controllable contactor, connector current sensor, control-pilot interface and local connector identifier; a branch current sensor measuring total current upstream of the connector contactors; the isolated local bus to connector interfaces and contactors; per-session storage of charging authorization, requested current, minimum sustaining current and energy-deficit value; per-interval subtraction of measured non-charging branch load and a configurable safety reserve from the branch limit; sustaining-first assignment then deficit-weighted distribution of the remainder; pilot delivery of assigned limits with connector-sensor verification; the reduced pilot command and verification interval; one-at-a-time opening in a stored shedding order until measured branch current is below the branch limit; the three reclosure conditions (zero connector current, connected vehicle reported at the pilot interface, expired randomized recovery delay); welded-contactor recording above a leakage threshold with inhibition of the other contactors on the branch and operation of a local fault indicator; network interface with signed local authorization token and last accepted branch limit in nonvolatile memory, outage continuation of authorized sessions and the token-plus-expiry bar on new sessions; tamper-evident meter sequence uploaded when communication returns; and the service-input mapping by one low-energy pilot transition at a time with storage only after the responding sensor agrees with the commanded channel. Figure geometry was checked against the functional-surface-geometry standard: the in-line branch sensor upstream of both channel drops and of the non-charging load drop follows from the disclosed "measures total current" plus the subtraction of measured non-charging branch load from the branch limit; the connector current sensor placed downstream of the contactor is compelled by the disclosed zero-current reclosure test and the post-open leakage test; the bus branches to the pilot interface and contactor follow the disclosed bus membership. The remaining outlines (dashed installation enclosure, square sensor outlines, empty blocks, rounded vehicle outline, flow-chart rectangles and diamond) are labeled "shown schematically" in the briefs, add no proportion, taper, angle, depth, runout, contact topology, material or flow-boundary assertion, and the convention stays inside the figure briefs: no "by way of example", "any closed outline" or shape-justifying embodiment language appears in the title, field, summary, drawing description, detailed description, claims or abstract, which all remain shape-neutral. Internal consistency was verified: claims and description use identical relationships and terms (branch current limit, assigned current limit, verification interval, stored shedding order, last accepted branch limit); each numeral denotes exactly one part and every numeral listed on a figure is described in the corresponding description passage; the FIG. 4 shape count (seven rectangles plus one diamond) matches the eight narrated steps 202-216, and the below-limit return, welded-condition terminator and reclosure return path match the description; no section lines are used, so no section-designation mismatch is possible; the abstract is a single paragraph under 150 words; no means-plus-function language is present; and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains. Prior-art characterizations in the Background were not scored for inventor support per the standing rule, and prior_art/ files were not part of the supplied material, so their tracing is left to the later citation review. No untraced technical assertion and no verified internal inconsistency was found, so the findings array is empty.

input.summary:
Full ledger built and traced. I read input/brief.md (formalities only: title, applicant/inventor Nimo Rotem, no priority claim, no federal support — matched by draft/02 and draft/03 "Not applicable."), input/conversation.md (single USER passage, truncated mid-sentence at "through a network interface, but"), and input/disclosure.md (the complete authority, including the offline-authorization, welded-contactor, tamper-evident-record and installation-mapping paragraphs that the truncated conversation does not reach).

Claims: every limitation of independent claims 1 and 11 and of dependent claims 2-10 and 12-16 was traced to an exact affirmative disclosure passage — the sub-rated branch ("whose allowable aggregate current is lower than the sum of the connector ratings"), the per-channel contactor/connector current sensor/control-pilot interface/local connector identifier, the upstream branch sensor ("measures total current upstream of the connector contactors"), the four stored per-session values, the interval subtraction of measured non-charging branch load and configurable safety reserve, sustaining-first then energy-deficit distribution, pilot send plus sensor verification, the reduced pilot command and verification interval ("remains above the branch limit after a reduced pilot command for a verification interval"), one-at-a-time shedding in a stored order until below limit (claims 2/12 re-measurement follows from "one at a time ... until"), the three-part reclosure gate, leakage-threshold welded-contactor recording with inhibition of the other contactors on the branch and local fault indicator, the isolated local bus, network interface plus nonvolatile signed token and last accepted branch limit with outage behaviour and token expiry, tamper-evident meter sequence uploaded on return, and the service-input mapping stored only after the sensed channel agrees. No claim recites matter absent from the disclosure and no claim is broader in relationship than the source; no means-plus-function language; apparatus and method classes only; antecedent bases resolve.

Numbered parts: all 25 numerals (100, 102, 104, 106, 108, 110, 112, 114, 116, 118, 120, 122, 124, 126, 128, 130, 140, 202-216) were checked against draft/numerals.md, the detailed description and the four figure briefs. Each numeral denotes exactly one part, each appears in at least one brief and in the description, no numeral in any brief is missing from the table, and no part carries two numerals. Each corresponds to a disclosed element (branch conductor for "one electrical branch", non-charging load for "measured non-charging branch load", electric vehicle for the pilot-reported "connected vehicle", and the eight steps for the disclosed allocation and protection sequence).

Figure briefs and drawing descriptions: FIG. 1-4 depict only source-supported structures and relationships. Substantive relationships that the briefs do assert were each traced — branch sensor upstream of all connector drops (source: "upstream of the connector contactors", "measures total current"), connector current sensor downstream of the contactor and on the run to the vehicle connector (required by "its connector current sensor reports zero" and the leakage-threshold test), bus reaching only the pilot interfaces and contactors and not the non-charging load (source: "communicates with the connector interfaces and contactors over an isolated local bus"), separate sensing lines from branch and connector sensors to the controller, local fault indicator external to and operated by the controller, and the FIG. 4 loop topology (return to allocation when below limit; shedding entered only after the verification interval; terminator where a welded condition is recorded, matching "inhibits the other contactors"). Enclosures, blocks, square sensor outlines and the rounded vehicle outline are shape-neutral generic outlines confined to the briefs and marked "shown schematically"; block placement inside FIG. 3 and the two illustrated connector channels are minimum-plurality/placement conventions that add no function, and the application text generalizes ("applies to each further connector channel"). No brief states a deeper end, runout, taper, angle, seal, port or contact topology, and no "by way of example" or "any closed outline" broadening statement appears anywhere in draft/04-10.

Text consistency: summary, detailed description, claims and abstract use the same terms and relationships ("connector channel", "branch current limit", "last accepted branch limit", "stored shedding order", "verification interval", "leakage threshold"); the step names in the description match the FIG. 4 brief and numerals table exactly; there are no section lines to designate; and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains. Background prior-art characterizations were left unreported per scope. No untraced technical assertion was found, so the findings array is empty.
